name: Step-3.5-Flash-SFT-Code-upload-bench
description: A code-focused evaluation dataset published on Hugging Face associated with PGCodeLLM. It is intended to measure code-generation and fine-tuned SFT model performance on uploaded/code-related tasks, focusing on functional correctness and practical execution-based evaluation. The benchmark emphasizes pass-rate-style evaluation (unit-test or execution-based) of generated code.
reputation: A community-contributed/code-SFT evaluation set with limited but growing use among code-model researchers and hobbyist SFT practitioners.
